exact_statement: There exists K_opt such that for every k >= K_opt there exists N_k for which Algorithm 1 returns an optimal memoryless deterministic policy with probability at least 1-delta_k.
assumptions: the memoryless deterministic policy set is finite
epsilon_diff is the positive gap from the optimal value to the best strictly suboptimal value
Theorem 3.1 supplies the epsilon_k-optimal event with probability at least 1-delta_k
pass_condition: A symbolic certificate proves the strict-gap event inclusion, an exact later K_opt exists, the independent rational-spectrum checker agrees, and the equality-boundary control is rejected.
fail_condition: A suboptimal policy is epsilon-optimal for epsilon < epsilon_diff, no strict later-stage witness exists, or an independent check disagrees.
